公开 topic 固定在 `/orbvi` 下。全景入口使用内置 `config/pano_mode2.yaml` /
`config/pano_mode2_ros2.yaml` 默认配置。默认以 2048x1024 完整角度画布投影，
上下各裁 200 行后发布 2048x624 图像；默认使用固定接缝、4 层 MultiBand，以及
鱼眼旋转/平移外参和可调的 2.0 m 有限拼接半径。物理相机映射固定为
`front=3、right=2、rear=4、left=5`。Host SDK 已将 RGB 与 rig 深度全景统一为

runtime_mount_provenance.text:
<!-- CZY /orbvi/imu is mounted with y,z opposite the Livox frame.
       Scan registration against IMU yaw and ascent geometry supports Rx(pi).
       This axis alignment is a dataset-specific estimate, not a full
       surveyed six-DOF extrinsic calibration. -->
  <arg name="lidar_to_imu_rotation" default="[1,0,0,0,-1,0,0,0,-1]" />
  <!-- Preserve the upstream Mid360 translation until a measured six-DOF
       calibration for this CZY rig is available. -->
  <arg name="lidar_to_imu_translation" default="[-0.011,-0.02329,0.04412]" />

<param name="common/lid_topic" value="$(arg lidar_topic)" />
  <param name="common/imu_topic" value="$(arg imu_topic)" />
  <param name="common/lidar_en" value="1" />
  <!-- CZY CustomMsg header/timebase is scan-start; per-point offset_time
       supplies the remaining ~100 ms. -->
  <param name="common/lidar_header_stamp_is_scan_end" value="false" />
  <!-- img_en is read as an integer by LIVMapper. -->
  <param name="common/img_en" value="0" />
  <param name="extrin_calib/extrinsic_R" type="yaml" value="$(arg lidar_to_imu_rotation)" />
  <param name="extrin_calib/extrinsic_T" type="yaml" value="$(arg lidar_to_imu_translation)" />

board_relative_pose_local_interpretation.text:
# Experimental four-fisheye extrinsics constrained by the rigid camera rig.
#
# cam_0 -> LiDAR uses the independently calibrated FAST-Calib result. The
# remaining camera<-LiDAR transforms are composed from that anchor and the
# camera poses Twc1/Twc2/Twc3 in the cam0 frame:
#   T_cam_i_lidar = inverse(T_cam0_cam_i) * T_cam0_lidar
# Twc translations were supplied in millimetres and converted to metres.
# Logical/source order and all VIO resource parameters intentionally match
# mid360_four.yaml so the extrinsic model is the only A/B variable.

raw_transforms, body_transforms, lidar_transforms = [], [], []
    for i in range(4):
        transform = np.eye(4)
        transform[:3, :] = matrix(raw[f"Twc{i}"])
        transform[:3, 3] *= 0.001  # camera_config Twc convention is millimetres.
        raw_transforms.append(transform)
        fast = read_yaml(fast_calib_dir / f"cam{i}_multi_calib_result.txt")
        lidar_transforms.append(rigid(np.asarray(fast["Rcl"]).reshape(3, 3), fast["Pcl"]))
